Pay Rate: $70.00 to $80.00 Per hour depending on experience

Please Note this role is on-site only 5 Days a week in Downtown Manhattan.

Are you a seasoned IT professional with a passion for revolutionizing Equity trading platforms? Join our dynamic team of consultants as we embark on the journey of building a cutting-edge Equity trading platform that promises to redefine the landscape of financial markets.

Key Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 12 years in the IT industry, with at least 8 years dedicated to working for US companies within the United States.

  • Financial Expertise: 5+ years of recent experience within the last 2 years working in a commercial environment for a major bank or brokerage house, with a strong background in capital markets and financial product knowledge.

  • Equity Trading Systems: 4+ years of hands-on experience in developing Equity Trading systems, with a focus on executing trades seamlessly. Recent participation in teams developing real-time or near real-time trading systems is a must.

  • Development Skills: A minimum of 10 years of experience in developing and enhancing .NET, C#, and C++ applications, specifically within the Equity domain.

  • Bloomberg Instruments: Recent experience utilizing Bloomberg instruments is essential.

  • Collaboration: Proven ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with trading desks, middle office personnel, and peer technology teams.

  • Application Support: Proficient in providing day-to-day Level 3 application support for multiple trading applications.

  • Agility: Familiarity with agile application development methodologies.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Equity Trading Platform Developer, you will be a vital part of our team responsible for building a new Equity trading platform. Your primary focus will be on developing the trading engine, designing innovative solutions, and overseeing their efficient implementation. Key responsibilities include:

  • Trade Execution: Prioritize the development of the trade execution process, ensuring seamless trades from initiation to completion.

  • Robust Design: Design and develop trading solutions with a commitment to building robust software components in a rapid/agile application development environment.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Possess in-depth knowledge of all rules, regulations, and intricacies involved in developing an Equity trading system, ensuring compliance at all levels.

  • Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of consultants to deliver high-quality results within the established timelines.

  • Communication: Maintain excellent communication skills to effectively liaise with trading desks, middle office personnel, and technology teams.

If you are a seasoned professional ready to leave a lasting mark on the financial industry, we invite you to join us on this exciting venture. Apply now to be a part of a team dedicated to shaping the future of Equity trading platforms.

Please note: This client is not accepting candidates submitted by other staffing firms or agencies at this time. Thank you.

Seeking an experienced Quantitative Researcher with strong analytical and programming skills and experience in an options market making group to contribute to research of new trading strategies and supporting and optimizing existing strategies and analytics.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Developing options pricing and risk models.
  • Enhancing real-time volatility valuation and fitting.
  • Researching predictive volatility alphas across various time horizons.

Qualified candidates will have:

  • Demonstrated experience with options pricing, volatility surfaces, and risk management.
  • Experience researching, implementing and executing trading signals
  • Relevant programming experience, preferably in Python and/or C++.
  • Must be detail oriented and have strong analytical skills

Salary: $120,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Work setting:

  • In-person
  • Office

About Us...

Oxford Nanopore Technologies is headquartered at the Oxford Science Park outside Oxford, UK, with satellite offices and commercial presence in many global locations across the US, APAC and Europe. Oxford Nanopore employs from multiple subject areas including nanopore science, molecular biology and applications, informatics, engineering, electronics, manufacturing and commercialization. The management team, led by CEO Dr Gordon Sanghera, has a track record of delivering disruptive technologies to the market.

Oxford Nanopore's sequencing platform is the only technology that offers real-time analysis (for rapid insights), in fully scalable formats from pocket to population scale, that can analyze native DNA or RNA and sequence any length of fragment to achieve short to ultra-long read lengths.

Our goal is to enable the analysis of any living thing, by anyone, anywhere. We offer real-time nanopore-based DNA/RNA sequencing technology: accessible, easy to use and fully scalable for any requirement.

The Details...

The Machine Learning Operations group at Oxford Nanopore Technologies is responsible for the engineering which enables the development and deployment of ML models and real-time analysis into production.

We are looking for a senior Bioinformatics engineer within the ML Ops group to help bring bioinformatics analysis into our suite of real-time software products.

This is a cross-functional role where the candidate will be working with science and engineering teams to:

· Develop bioinformatics algorithms for real-time analysis of Oxford Nanopore data.

· Design, implement and ship efficient implementations of methods into production for use by the entire Nanopore community.

· Work together with the core machine learning team on business-critical problems.

· Keep up to date with the latest development in bioinformatics and feed that into tactical and strategic plans.

· Mentor junior employees and present their knowledge of bioinformatics to the wider ML group.

What We're Looking For...

We value a diverse range of experiences and backgrounds. While an MSc in a scientific or computational subject area (such as Bioinformatics, Biology, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, etc.) is preferred, we're open to candidates with equivalent experience and a passion for the field. Experience working with bioinformatics tools and familiarity with C++ is expected.

Ways to stand out:

· Strong background in bioinformatics algorithmics or tools development.

· Experience with modern C++.

· Contributions to open-source projects, preferably in bioinformatics and/or machine learning.

· Familiarity with Natural Language Processing, time series analysis or Oxford Nanopore data.

· Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, demonstrating strong communication and collaboration skills.

The salary for this role is between $104,600 and $156,900 USD. The salary offered will reflect the skills and experience of the candidate.

Certain roles within ONT are eligible annual bonus and stock. These awards are allocated based on individual performance.

Employees based in the US have the option to choose healthcare benefits, participate in the company 401(k) plan and company match, we also offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and commuter benefits to name a few.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Oxford Nanopore's goal is to bring the widest benefits to society through enabling the analysis of anything, by anyone, anywhere. The company has developed a new generation of nanopore-based sensing technology enabling the real-time, high-performance, accessible and scalable analysis of DNA and RNA. The technology is used in more than 100 countries to understand the biology of humans and diseases, plants, animals, bacteria, viruses and whole environments.

Oxford Nanopore was founded in 2005 as a spin-out from the University of Oxford and now employs over 1000 employees around the world.

Sr.Data Engineer (Must have a strong background in Molecular Dynamics/Small Molecules)
Location: Manhattan (on-site)
Salary: 300-550K + Bonus
Relocation is available
Sponsorship is available.

Ideal candidate will have extensive experience with large-scale data management, strong Python programming skills, experience with Client systems, frameworks, and data lifecycles; and a background in data structures and algorithms. Relevant areas of expertise include engineering of large-scale chemical databases, experience with architecting infrastructure for the handling of life science data, fluency with UNIX/Linux command-line tools like awk and sed, and familiarity writing scientific software, but specific knowledge of any of these areas is less critical than intellectual curiosity, versatility, and a track record of achievement.
Relevant experience:
  • Demonstrated experience with large-scale data management in the life sciences (ideally dealing with chemistry databases), data structures and algorithms
  • Experience architecting infrastructure for the handling of life science data
  • Writing scientific software
  • Industry experience required (above three years minimum)
  • Python programming skills a must; C++ is a nice to have

Responsibilities: creating systems and infrastructure for modeling, curating, and indexing the petabytes of data generated by our special-purpose supercomputers and our large Linux HPC and GPU clusters; to implementing pipelines for processing computational and experimental data sets; and to developing and maintaining data management policies and toolkits for drug discovery data processing
